svg.title: How the server is wired
svg.desc: Shopify webhooks reach n8n through Cloudflare and a tunnel the server opens outward. The owner reaches SSH and the n8n editor only over Tailscale. n8n calls Slack and Shopify outward. The firewall drops everything else.
svg.text: The rehearsal VM on the laptop (step 1.13). The cloud server at 1.14 is the same picture without the laptop around it.
